verdict.rationale: Wave's docs clearly show invoice creation with branding/templates, online payment collection via 'Pay now' (credit card, bank/ACH, Apple Pay), and visibility into when invoices are viewed, due, or paid, directly matching the story. This is core, well-documented first-party functionality (invoicing + payments + status tracking) explicitly marketed as integrated. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
